alpha_convention: The --alphas value is the selected metric's Bernoulli probability.
auxiliary_metrics: Fid- records p_full - avg_p(H_minus); Fid+ records p_full - avg_p(H_plus); FidDelta records Fid+ - Fid-.
context_policy: Fid-: selected edges are always retained and non-selected candidate edges are retained with probability alpha. Fid+: selected edges are dropped with probability alpha from the candidate graph, so alpha=0.1 retains most edges. FidDelta combines both on the same selected mask, using alpha_minus=alpha and alpha_plus=1-alpha. SAA-Enum and SAA-MILP use fixed optimization scenarios; inference uses independently fixed evaluation scenarios.
counterexample_decision_rule: counterexample_supported iff the two-sided paired-t CI for the oriented MILP advantage lies strictly above zero; per-instance intervals are unadjusted for searching across multiple instances
gt_no_good_cut_definition: sum_{e in S_GT}(1-z_e) + sum_{e not in S_GT}z_e >= 1
gurobi_norel_hybrid_time_scope: NoRel and subsequent root/B&B share the existing single Gurobi time limit; no model restart
metric_formula: fid_minus = p_full(c_star | E_c) - mean p_model(c_star | H_minus)
node_enumeration_inference_context: compact candidate-edge support plus root; global cache/artifact edge IDs preserved
saa_enum_concrete_mode_policy: per source row: connectivity=none -> all; node cut/flow -> rooted; graph cut/flow -> connected
saa_enum_extrema_evaluation: both extrema and GT evaluated on the same independent evaluation scenarios
saa_enum_gt_rank: both directions on fixed optimization scenarios; GT counted once even when excluded by no-good
saa_milp_objective_note: prob_pwl is a sigmoid PWL approximation used only for SAA-MILP candidate generation. The dense sigmoid domain is derived from tail_eps by B=log((1-tail_eps)/tail_eps); outside [-B, B], the approximation is clamped to tail_eps and 1-tail_eps. All fid_alpha, nec_alpha, and score_alpha values are computed by true torch probabilities.
saa_table_formulation: prob_table: scenario s depends on S only through S∩D_s (switch edges); true torch probabilities p_s(T) for all T⊆D_s with |T|<=K; continuous lambda_{s,T} with sum_T lambda=1 and z_e=sum_{T∋e} lambda for e in D_s; node tasks drop edges whose endpoints both lie at distance >= num_layers from the target
source_selection: direct dataset/GT rows: SAA-MILP does not require a standard-fidelity source run
